QuestInfo.name: Perion Homestyle Cooking
QuestInfo.0: Blackbull seems to like you well enough...he wants to enjoy a salad with you, in fact. What a nice guy! Get some details from him.
QuestInfo.1: Blackbull wants a #bFire Flower#k to cook his Wild Boar's meat just right. That sounds like a noble cause. #rYou can find many Fire Flowers in #m102020200# and #m102020100#. Deal with the #bDark Stumps#k there while you're at it!
QuestInfo.2: Blackbull wants a #bFire Flower#k to cook his Wild Boar's meat just right. That sounds like a noble cause. #rYou can find many Fire Flowers in #m102020200# and #m102020100#. Deal with the #bDark Stumps#k there while you're at it!

0.0: Hm...you look like you might be tough enough to do me a favor. Feel honored, kid. I need #rFire Flowers#k to cook my Wild Boar Meat. They're these hot flowers that bloom in barren places. Find me one in #m102020200# and #m102020100#.

yes.0: Hurry up! Go get me a Fire Flower, before my meat spoils. If it spoils, I'll cook YOU instead!
yes.1: The Fire Flowers bloom all over #m102020200# or #m102020100#. Now go on.\r\n

no.0: Oh, you're NOT going to get me a Fire Flower? I don't think you understand who you're talking to! How about you try answering again?

1.0: My meat's getting cold. Did you bring the Fire Flowers?

yes.0: Hey, good job. Now I can warm up my dinner. Okay, I'm done with you. Run along back to #bAyan#k.

item.0: I don't feel the heat! Where are my Fire Flowers?
